Supplier Document Intelligence

The important question isn't only what the AI extracted. It's whether someone can verify it.

What it is
A procurement-review prototype that reads supplier quotations and specifications, checks them against each other, flags conflicts, and prepares an approved ERP draft — with the source evidence beside every value.
Who it's for
Procurement and supplier-pricing analysts who prepare the data, and procurement managers who approve it.
Problems it solves
  • Quotations and specifications arrive in inconsistent formats; one wrong quantity break or outdated revision causes downstream errors.
  • A generic AI extraction shows a neat result, but not where each value came from or whether two documents disagree.
  • Re-typing data into ERP is slow — yet automating it must not hide who checked and approved the change.
My role
Requirements analysis · product flow · AI-assisted prototyping · evidence design · testing (client project at YBBE TECH, anonymised)
Next: FanScope →

Status & limits A synthetic-document prototype: no measured extraction accuracy, certified pipeline or production ERP connection is claimed, and nothing is posted, ordered or paid automatically.
